hotel_name: Townhouse Dilshad Garden Near Dilshad Garden Metro Station

negative_snippets:
Front desk staff are under qualified rooms are not cleaned before check-ins
Dirty washrooms cellphone call before arrival for making some changes no response their either

Absolutely the worst hotel experience ever. The room was filthy and stinking — insects crawling around, piles of paan spit inside, dirty and unwashed bedsheets/pillow covers, and no lock provided for safety. The entire place was unhygienic and unsafe. To make it worse, there was no board or signage for the hotel, making it nearly impossible to locate. This property is disgusting, a complete scam, and should be avoided at all costs.

The rooms are absolutely filthy. The linens, including the pillows, were black and dirty. There were hairs everywhere and stains on the bedsheets and mattress. The bathroom and sink hadn’t been cleaned at all. The towel holder was broken, switches were damaged, and even the furniture was falling apart. The AC sounded like a generator.

The entire place is pathetic and unhygienic. It might be okay for low-class couples looking to spend 2–3 hours for ₹300–₹400, but even then, it's a disgrace. On top of that, they charged me extra for being a solo traveler at midnight. The amount on the OYO app was ₹699, but they forced me to pay ₹1,298. I had no option but to pay in cash since it was 12:30 at night and I didn’t want to go searching for another hotel.

They are cheaters, looters, and absolutely unprofessional people who have no idea what hospitality means.
